capabilities: Rate the current note from 0 to 5 (decimals allowed) via a status bar input
Store ratings as a numeric rating property in YAML frontmatter
Show a star rating widget at the top of the document
Filter markdown notes by rating threshold, equality, or comparison in a panel
Set ratings and open the filter panel through commands and a ribbon icon
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README states it makes no network requests and stores all data locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to assign star ratings to notes or find notes by rating.
summary: Star-rating plugin that lets users rate notes 0-5, stores ratings as a numeric frontmatter property, and filters notes by rating.
